regression profile only: a save created by the maintainers (absent from the disc). It is NOT required: a fresh installation with an empty SAVE directory is the supported 'no-saves' profile. If SAVE contains anything else, the build refuses it.

disc.note: The cue sheet text depends on how the image was ripped (file names, line endings). The CD content is identified by the per-track SHA-256 values below plus the derived MSCDEX layout asserted by the build; the build accepts a cue whose tracks hash to these values.

save_profiles.no-saves: SAVE is empty or absent (fresh installation); the replays expect the original OPTIONS plug-in to probe SAVE0.SAV, receive DOS file-not-found and read no save
save_profiles.reference-save: SAVE holds exactly the reference SAVE0.SAV (SHA-256 in the install_files entry); the replays expect the original plug-in to read it
